annotations.title: chainpeek: a read-only contract call (eth_call) on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Call a smart contract function read-only on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For gas units use estimate_gas; for a raw storage slot use get_storage_at. Returns the raw ABI-encoded return data (`result`, `result_bytes`) of eth_call against `to` with your calldata at `latest`, `pending`, `finalized` or a block number; nothing is signed or sent. The result is not decoded (decode_calldata decodes calldata; the ABI is yours). A call that reverts is a 422 `reverted` (not charged); results over 32 kB are a 502. Old blocks need an archive node and may fail. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html

block.description: latest (default), pending, finalized or a block number (older blocks need an archive node and may fail).
